title: Glessner House granite reads as whole stones, not triangles
items: Up close, each rock-faced stone on the Glessner House used to break into a mosaic of small light and dark triangles. Each stone now shows one continuous granite grain across its face, and its pitched relief shades smoothly.
The stone colour, the courses and the light are unchanged. The shaded north and west faces still show their relief only faintly, and that is the next piece of work.
